  • det3 X neighbour asymmetry: an audit 2026-10-21DetectorCrosstalk

    Fresh-eyes summary of the week-long study, updated the same evening. Every June board carries a smooth, two-signed, X-only field that moves charge straight from neighbour n−1 to n+1, with a size set by the cloud width alone (not gain, not time). Electronics, connectors, copper, copies, linear coupling, Y→X transfer, charging and gap conduction are excluded; the 6-19/20 outlier was det2. A pull toward the strips is still possible (the sharing test does not decide it) but no simulated version is big enough. Fingerprint and ranked plan.
